verdict.rationale: Xero exposes an MCP server, OpenAPI/SDKs, and an 'AI Toolkit' (OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain) that let developers build agents/automations against Xero data, and features like JAX perform AI-assisted reconciliation/invoicing — but these are largely developer-facing integrations or assisted (not autonomous, user-configured) workflows, with no evidence of a built-in autonomous background automation/workflow builder for end users.
